query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.saleType,
  s.finalAmount,
  COUNT(si.id) as total_itens
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN saleItems si ON s.id = si.saleId
WHERE s.id = 8130002
GROUP BY s.id
